prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1285; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision referenced above. The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with a certified copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm in writing that your insured has been placed on notice of this claim.

We further ask that you preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including vehicle data, photographs, recorded statements, claim file materials, telematics information, and any repair or salvage records for both vehicles. Please treat this letter as formal notice of our client's claim and of the need to preserve all relevant materials pending resolution of this matter.
